bg-cozy-ukulele.prompt: Light, cheerful, cozy background music for a friendly educational cartoon set in a Saigon street-food alley. Acoustic ukulele, soft acoustic guitar, gentle hand percussion and light glockenspiel. Warm, happy, unobtrusive, mid-tempo around 100 BPM, steady from start to end so it can loop. No vocals, no drops.

jingle-yolo7.prompt: A 4-second cheerful channel jingle for a kids-friendly English learning cartoon: bright ukulele strum, a quick bicycle bell ring, and a playful glockenspiel sparkle ending on a happy resolved chord. No vocals.
